types.description: PLL lock and slip status information

functions.name: Init
functions.description: Initialize the PLL and clock system with default configuration from SOC YAML. Configures PLL1, clock sources, dividers, and enables all clock domains. This function implements the complete initialization sequence from x-ext.init.

functions.name: GetFrequency
functions.description: Get the frequency in Hz for the specified clock domain. Returns 0 if domain is invalid or disabled. This is the primary clock service API used by all peripheral drivers.

functions.name: EnableClock
functions.description: Enable the specified clock domain. Must be called by peripheral drivers before accessing peripheral registers. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success or error code on failure.

functions.name: DisableClock
functions.description: Disable the specified clock domain. Use with caution - only disable clocks when peripheral is confirmed inactive. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success.

functions.name: ConfigurePLL
functions.description: Configure PLL parameters at runtime (advanced use only). Disables PLL, applies new configuration, waits for lock. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success, PLL_STATUS_NOT_LOCKED if lock fails, or PLL_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM for invalid parameters.

functions.name: SetClockDivider
functions.description: Configure clock domain divider ratio. Applies to configurable domains (VCLK, VCLK2, VCLK3, VCLK4). Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success or PLL_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM if domain does not support divider configuration.

functions.name: GetLockStatus
functions.description: Read PLL lock status and clock slip detection flags. Populates the provided status structure with current PLL1/PLL2 lock state and slip detection.

functions.name: WaitForLock
functions.description: Poll for PLL lock with timeout. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK when locked, PLL_STATUS_TIMEOUT if timeout expires. Timeout of 0 means infinite wait.

functions.name: EnablePLL
functions.description: Enable the specified PLL instance. Waits for PLL lock before returning. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success or PLL_STATUS_NOT_LOCKED on failure.

functions.name: DisablePLL
functions.description: Disable the specified PLL instance. Use with extreme caution - may affect system clocks. Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success.

functions.name: ClearClockSlipStatus
functions.description: Clear clock slip detection flags in GLBSTAT register. Should be called after handling a clock slip event.

functions.name: GetOscillatorFrequency
functions.description: Get the external oscillator (OSCIN) frequency in Hz. Returns the configured OSCIN frequency (typically 16 MHz).

functions.name: SelectClockSource
functions.description: Select clock source for a configurable clock domain. Source_id values are device-specific (see GHVSRC, RCLKSRC, VCLKASRC register mappings). Returns PLL_STATUS_OK on success or PLL_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM if domain or source is invalid.
